items.title: Kering stock steadies as Gucci reset lifts earnings
items.summary: Paris-exchange market commentary on Kering (KER-FR) describes Gucci's turnaround as an emerging earnings recovery: Q2 revenue of EUR1.41B was down only 2% YoY (vs -5% in H1), operating margin in fashion/leather goods expanded 0.4pp, and H1 underlying free cash flow reached EUR1.8B. Jewelry (+18%) and eyewear (+8%) continue to cushion the group while Gucci's rebound is still framed by analysts as fragile and largely priced in already.

items.title: Kering stock trades lower as Gucci's turnaround lifts H1 jewelry growth
items.summary: Paris-listed Kering shares slipped 0.28% to EUR57.06 on Aug 13 despite improving Gucci fundamentals, as investors weighed mixed H1 2026 results. Gucci's Q2 revenue decline narrowed to 2% (from -8% in Q1); jewelry sales rose 14% for H1. Piece frames the modest stock dip as caution about how durable Gucci's stabilization is, even as pricing discipline and cost efficiency show up in margins.
